description: Paired rhythm-layer A/B on the isolated influenza_a arm across the four real cruise classes. Every cell runs the FLU-DELIVERY-01 confined-window conditioning verbatim: active_profiles bundle with the other two pathogens removed, explicit passenger seed pair at epoch 0, declared SOP-017 confinement day 1 to end, k shipped at 0.0006/copy (no overrides). Frozen gates: (1) rhythm.enabled=false on post-#742 main must reproduce the pre-rhythm tree's per-epoch state digests byte-identically before any cell runs; (2) a canary confined-window cell must show emitted metrics move under rhythm.on or the flag is reported inert and the campaign stops; (3) readout is descriptive — confined cabinmate attack fraction vs the 15-25% floor per class per arm, delivered confined dose, per-epoch dosed-set size, challenged share, corridor-front correlation — declared here before runs; no constant is retuned on the result.
